Here, T is a subset of S means every 1-bit of T is also a 1-bit of S, equivalently (T & S) = T.
Compute the values B[0], B[1], ..., B[2^m - 1] in increasing bitmask order.
Let subset_zeta_transform_result_1 be this sequence B.
Output the result as task_1_out = {"result": subset_zeta_transform_result_1}, replacing subset_zeta_transform_result_1 with its calculated value.

To achieve the required dimension for the reshape, you can append zeros to the end of list task_2_input or truncate it.
Compute the 1-norm of matrix_1_2 (the maximum absolute column sum).
